# Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R

This course covers time-to-event analysis for clinical and epidemiological research using R, with emphasis on interpretation and reproducible reporting.

## Target Audience

Clinicians, clinical researchers, PhD students, epidemiologists, and analysts working with follow-up data, event outcomes, or prognostic studies.

## Practical Information

| Item | Information |
|---|---|
| Format | Online |
| Schedule | Monday, Wednesday, Friday |
| Time | 17:00-19:00 Morocco time |
| Price | 1500 DH |
| Seats | 20 participants maximum |
| Registration | Opens 10 days before course start |

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

- structure time-to-event data in R;
- estimate and interpret Kaplan-Meier curves;
- fit and interpret Cox proportional hazards models;
- check key survival model assumptions;
- communicate survival results in clinical research reports.
